seo.title: Chat in real time
seo.description: ConvoTalk - Chat in real time with the people who matter. A complete platform for instant messaging, groups, audio and video calls, and file sharing.
seo.structuredDescription: A complete platform for instant messaging, groups, audio and video calls, and real-time file sharing.

hero.title: Chat. Share. Connect.
hero.subtitle: A complete platform for instant messaging, groups, audio and video calls, and file sharing.
hero.previewHint: Try ConvoTalk — Send a message and watch communication happen in real time.

features.title: Everything you need to chat
features.subtitle: More than messages. ConvoTalk brings the main communication tools together in one place.
features.realtimeDescription: Send and receive messages instantly with typing indicators, online presence and read receipts.
features.groupsDescription: Chat one-on-one or bring several people into the same conversation with dedicated topic channels.
features.callsDescription: Start calls directly from a conversation using peer-to-peer real-time communication via WebRTC.
features.filesDescription: Send images, documents, audio and other files directly through the chat with instant previews.
features.organizeDescription: Reply, pin, react, edit and organize your messages while keeping priorities visible to everyone.
features.searchDescription: Quickly find messages, contacts and information inside your conversations using quick commands.

messaging.title: More than just messages
messaging.subtitle: A communication experience built for conversations that never stop. Stay in sync with quick replies and preserved context.
messaging.list2: Online status and instant presence with WebSockets
messaging.list6: Messages pinned to the top of the chat
messaging.list7: Quick editing and safe, traceless deletion

chatMockup.message1: The WebSocket APIs are already responding with latency below 20ms.
chatMockup.message2: Excellent! I just ran the stress test suite and it handled 10k simultaneous connections.
chatMockup.draft: Great! Shall we open the demo call?

calls.title: When a message isn't enough
calls.subtitle: Start an audio or video call directly from the conversation with zero friction, no external software or plugins.
calls.audioDescription: Crystal-clear voice processed by the browser with native echo suppression.
calls.videoDescription: Smooth resolution that adapts to your connection speed.
calls.controlsDescription: Switch microphone, turn on your camera or share your screen in one click.

groups.title: Chat your way: from one-on-one to large teams
groups.subtitle: Create topic rooms, manage participants and centralize discussions with full moderation and privilege control.
groups.announcement: ConvoTalk stack updated successfully at 10:00 UTC.
groups.message1: Everyone, the call channel for the daily stand-up is open in the meeting room.
groups.message2: Joining now! I've already left the pull request ready for review.
groups.membersPermissionsText: Granular admin, moderator and member roles to control who can send messages, pin or moderate.
groups.notificationsText: Mute secondary conversations or get instant notifications only when you're mentioned with @name.
groups.profilesText: Rich identity with custom statuses, bio, links and avatars that make each member easy to recognize.

files.title: Share more than messages
files.subtitle: Send files without losing their original quality. Keep important documents, voice notes and screenshots in the continuous flow of the conversation.
files.exportText: Keep a record of your conversations and channels by easily exporting them to formatted PDF with official timestamps.

pwa.title: Your conversations, wherever you are
pwa.subtitle: A modern, responsive web experience ready for any device, even when the signal drops.
pwa.installText: Install on Windows, macOS, Android or iOS without going through app stores. A full-screen experience identical to a native app.
pwa.offlineText: Browse your message history and recent attachments even without an internet connection. Instant local cache with zero white screens.
pwa.queueText: Send messages even offline; ConvoTalk queues and syncs everything to the server automatically as soon as the connection returns.

security.title: Security at every layer
security.subtitle: Engineered with technical rigor to keep your conversations and data fully protected from unwanted access.
security.authText: Short-lived JWT access tokens with continuous refresh token rotation, stored exclusively in HTTP-only cookies and protected against XSS attacks.
security.abuseText: Multi-layered rate limiting for both REST endpoints in the Express API and real-time Socket.IO events, neutralizing abuse and spam.
security.validationText: Full payload validation and sanitization with rigorous Zod schemas at runtime, providing structural prevention against SQL/NoSQL injection and malicious data.
security.secureCommsText: Encrypted tunnels via HTTPS and secure WebSockets (WSS), plus modern CSP security headers and restrictive end-to-end CORS policies.
security.filesNote: Files protected with MIME type verification and secure storage.

architecture.title: Built for real-time communication
architecture.subtitle: A modern, reactive architecture created to deliver very high performance, low latency and continuous horizontal scalability.
architecture.frontendText: Offline-first PWA, WebSockets Client & WebRTC Media Engine.
architecture.gatewayText: Socket.IO Clusters, JWT Auth Middleware and Rate Limiters.
architecture.databaseText: Indexed collections, channel persistence and media uploads.

howItWorks.title: Get started in seconds
howItWorks.subtitle: No complicated setup or heavy installations.
howItWorks.step1Text: Set up your profile, choose your username and personalize your account in seconds.
howItWorks.step2Text: Look up registered contacts through instant search or join public rooms and topic groups.
howItWorks.step3Text: Send messages, transfer files or start a video conference with a single click.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about ConvoTalk.
faq.a1: Yes! ConvoTalk is a free platform.
faq.q2: Do I need an account to use it?
faq.a2: You can try public demos instantly, but to keep persistent history and manage groups you just need to create an account in under 1 minute.
faq.a3: Yes, ConvoTalk integrates real-time peer-to-peer audio and video calls using WebRTC with high fidelity and low latency, without relying on third-party software.
faq.a4: Yes, you can create groups with multiple members, admin controls and pinned messages.
faq.a5: Yes, you can attach images, PDF documents, spreadsheets and recorded voice messages directly in the chat with MIME type validation.
faq.q6: Can I use ConvoTalk on my phone?
faq.a6: Yes! ConvoTalk was built as a PWA (Progressive Web App), working perfectly in mobile browsers.
faq.a7: All connections use encrypted HTTPS/WSS tunnels, HTTP-only cookie authentication, rate limiting and strict Zod schema validation on every message transmitted.
